**Why:** Before the fix, the user picker in the stock user-role-scope workspace loaded one page of users with `useUsers({ v: default })` and no `limit` or `q`. The REST module returns a default-sized page when no limit is given, which I did not verify in the webservices code. The picker then filtered only that page on the client, so any user past the first page could never be found or assigned a location-scoped role. The fix replaces this with server-side search: `useSearchUser` sends `q` and `limit` to `/user` as the admin types, with a debounce.

**Which change:** Commit `12a145551cda444d3c1a79e62699b7735b8dc892` ("(feat) Migrate stock management to workspace v2 (#661)") introduced the server-side search. Its diff to the workspace file removes the `useUsers` call and the client-side `filterItems`, and adds `useSearchUser` with `setSearchString`. The commit message does not mention the search change. The code comment at the call site cites **O3-4518**.

**Ticket:** O3-4518, as cited in the code comment. I found no commit message that names it. Searching commits for "O3-4518" and "4518" returned nothing.

**Related history:** Commit `a23eb53452099c74cea9629e0b3a62722a9edfd4` (2024, #133) is titled "user roles aren't showing all users in the event users are more the default rest page size". Its diff does not change the page size or add search. It changes the `useUser` URL and the selected-user state, so I treat it as an earlier report of the same symptom, not the fix.

Commit 12a14555 is the change that added the search. The 2024 commit a23eb53 is the earlier report of the same symptom.
